summary: Adding FAQ sections with Schema markup historically improves rankings for informational and transactional keywords.
insight: Search engines award rich snippet real estate when FAQ schema matches user query intent.

summary: Internal linking consistently helps pages ranking between positions 8-30 recover momentum and move to Top 10.
insight: Passing page equity from high-traffic blog articles to target landing pages yields measurable ranking gains within 3-4 weeks.

summary: Removing primary keyword terms from title tags for brand aesthetic frequently causes rapid ranking drops.
insight: Exact-match or phrase-match keywords in `<title>` tags remain a non-negotiable relevance signal.

summary: Competitor mass-content publishing is followed by visibility declines across non-updated pages within 30-45 days.
insight: Proactive content refresh is required when competitors publish >10 topic-cluster articles.
